An identifier other than `sub`, then `[` or `{`, inside a sigil's braces is
the variable's name, as toke.c's scan_ident reads it (issue
01a16e20-f266-7b4e-a98d-7a9ecbf65690): `@{ foo { "a" } }` is the slice
`@foo{"a"}`, from uni/variables.t:402. A sub of that name, its prototype and
`use strict` play no part. Each row's comment quotes perl 5.44.0's
-MO=Concise or Deparse,-p.

=== uni/variables.t's shape, after an &-prototype sub
sub foo (&) { [1] }
my %foo = (a=>2);
my $ret = @{ foo { "a" } };
--- facts
faithful
# d  <@> hslice sK ->e
#    b  <$> const[PV "a"] s ->c
# Deparse,-p: (my($ret) = @foo{'a'});

=== the same with a newline inside the braces
sub foo (&) { [1] }
my %foo = (a=>2);
my $ret = @{
        foo { "a" }
    };
--- facts
faithful
# Deparse,-p: (my($ret) = @foo{'a'});

=== a package hash, with no sub
use strict;
our %foo = (a=>2);
my @r = @{ foo { "a" } };
--- facts
rv2hv 2 exact
faithful
# one rv2hv for the assignment to %foo, and under the hslice:
# 7  <1> rv2hv[t3] sKR ->8

=== a $-prototype sub and an array element
sub foo ($) { [1] }
our @foo = (1);
my $x = ${ foo [0] };
--- facts
faithful
# Deparse,-p: (my($x) = $foo[0]);

=== a subscript chain and a subscript after the braces
our %foo;
my $x = ${ foo {a} {b} };
my $y = ${ foo {a} }{b};
--- facts
rv2hv 1 exact
faithful
# Deparse,-p: (my($x) = $foo{'a'}{'b'}); (my($y) = $foo{'a'}{'b'});

=== sub is excluded: a deref of an anonymous sub's result
my @r = @{ sub {[1]}->() };
--- facts
faithful

=== a leading :: is no name: a deref of a call
our %h;
my @r = @{ ::foo { $h{b} } };
--- facts
rv2hv 1 exact
faithful
# perl's one rv2hv is %h's; the braces are rv2av over entersub

=== a leading :: is no name, with a lexical hash inside
my %h;
my @r = @{ ::foo { %h } };
my @s = @{ ::foo {"a"} };
--- facts
faithful
# no rv2hv: rv2av over entersub/method_redir
